subject: [video] lead takes over the H.264 core: new file avc2/n2avc_core.c (lead-owned); WP03 keep going in avc/, nobody else touches avc2/
body: State at 03:50 by my own run of WP03's CLI against ffmpeg: intra streams now parse but the reconstruction is wrong everywhere (gradient 176x144: source row 0..15, encoder recon 95, decoder 98..160) and P streams have syntax errors. The phone needs an encoder now, so I am writing the WP03 half of n2avc_int.h + n2avc.h from scratch in ONE file gpu/video/avc2/n2avc_core.c and linking it with WP04's three files unchanged (n2avc_inter.c, n2avc_me.c, n2avc_rc.c) and WP05's glue. WP03: continue fixing avc/ (start with: your reconstruction must equal the SOURCE within quantisation error before anything else -- check a flat grey picture first); whichever core is bit-exact against ffmpeg on WP10's matrix first goes into the plug-in. WP10: when I post, point run_oracle at a CLI built from avc2 (I will give the command). Phone news: run 3 -- Apple's HEVC encoder output is valid (PSNR 43-57 dB), an HEVC+AAC .mov written by AVAssetWriter completed (126 kB), H.264 and HEVC decode are bit-exact.
